uncited: This family defines the geometric primitives used to represent 3D scenes in differentiable splatting methods, extending the standard 3D Gaussian ellipsoid to alternative shapes, distributions, and dimensionalities.
It differs from sibling methods by varying the fundamental density function or geometric support of the primitive while maintaining the core splatting pipeline of projection and alpha compositing.
The concept of using explicit geometric primitives for differentiable rendering has evolved from neural radiance fields to explicit point-based representations.
